Study Specific Derivation. Planned treatment attributed to a record for analysis purposes. If populated, TRTP must match at least one value of the character planned treatment variables in ADSL (e.g., TRTxxP, TRTSEQP, TRxxPGy).

Compare ADT/ASTDT to the series of ADSL.APxxSDT and ADSL.APxxEDT dates to determine which set of dates it falls between. Set this variable to the corresponding value of xx from ADSL.TRTxxP variable.

Contains the number of days from the first exposure date in the period that the spontaneous event occurred (if the exposure date is prior to the spontaneous event date), or the first exposure date of the previous period (if the exposure date in this period is after the spontaneous event date) to ASTDT. If value >=0 then add 1.

Contains the number of days from the first exposure date in the period that the spontaneous event occurred (if the exposure date is prior to the spontaneous event date), or the first exposure date of the previous period (if the exposure date in this period is after the spontaneous event date) to AENDT. If value >=0 then add 1.
ASTDT - ADSL.TRTSDT. If value >=0 then add 1.
AENDT - ADSL.TRTSDT. If value >=0 then add 1.

[Study specific] See SAP for high and low ranges. If CHG<LOW RANGE VALUE then set to 'L'. If CHG> HIGH RANGE VALUE then set to 'H'. If LOW RANGE VALUE<=CHG<= HIGH RANGE VALUE then set to 'I'. If CHG is missing and "DURING TREATMENT" (defined per SAP) then set to 'U'. If ABLFL='Y' then set to 'P'. If ABLFL = 'Y' and "PRE TREATMENT" (Defined per SAP) then set to 'R'. When high/low ranges are not provided then set to 'N'. If Upper/Lower Increases/Decreases are defined compare CHG to these values to determine if they meet this criteria and set CHGCA1CD values per controlled term

Derive for post-baseline ATOXGRN values. If BTOXGRN is missing assume is it 0. If ATOXGRN = 1 and BTOXGRN < ATOXGRN then SHIFT2N=1 ("Increase to Grade 1"). Else if baseline record has A1INDCD in ("L'" or "H") and post-baseline record has A1INDCD="I" or A1INDCD at baseline equals the post-baseline A1INDCD value , set SHIFT1N=2

Check, if there is a related disposition record (DSCAT="DISPOSITION EVENT") in SDTM.DS for a serious adverse event or a non-serious adverse event (see below for logic for the relation). If additionally the upcased value of ADSL.EOSSTT equals to "WITHDRAWAL" then assign a value of "WITHDRAWN FROM STUDY" to AAEACNOT. Otherwise copy value from AE.AEACNOTH.To check if there is a related record in SDTM.DS use the following logic:1) Check, if there is a record in SDTM.RELREC, where AE.USUBJID = RELREC.USUBJID and RELREC.RDOMAIN = "AE" and RELREC.RELID begins with "DS".For non-serious adverse events note RELREC.RELID when AE.AESPID equals RELREC.IDVARVAL For serious adverse events note RELREC.RELID when AE.AEGRPID equals RELREC.IDVARVAL2) Note IDVARVAL for given USUBJID/ RELID if there is a record in SDTM.RELREC where RDOMAIN equals to "DS" 3) Merge on each related DSTERM where DS.DSSEQ = RELREC.IDVARVAL (onto record identified via the RELREC dataset)4) If UPCASE(ADSL.EOSSTT) equals "WITHDRAWAL" any of the related disposition records (DSCAT="DISPOSITION EVEN") where DS.DSTERM(s) are equal "SERIOUS ADVERSE EVENT AND/OR PIMD" or "NON-SERIOUS ADVERSE EVENT" are considered to be related to study withdrawal, which means, that AAEACNOT is set to "WITHDRAWN FROM STUDY".
Assign value 'Dose 1' for ADAE.ASPER = 1, 'Dose 2' for ADAE.ASPER = 2

Combine SDTM.SUPPEC and SDTM.EC by USUBJID and where EC.ECSEQ equals the numeric version of SUPPEC.IDVARVAL.For non serious AEs:From the combined EC/SUPPEC dataset , extract SUPPEC.ECREASC and SUPPEC.ECREASCX using following logic:1) if there is a record in RELREC where AE.USUBJID = RELREC.USUBJID and AE.AESPID = RELREC.IDVARVAL and RELREC.RELID begins with "EC" (WHERE RELREC.RDOMAIN = "AE") note the RELID.2) for given USUBJID/ RELID if there is a record in RELREC where RDOMAIN is "EC" (note the IDVARVAL) 3) Merge on SUPPEC. ECREASC and SUPPEC.ECREASCX where EC.ECSEQ = RELREC.IDVARVAL (onto record identified via the RELREC dataset)For serious AEs repeat steps 1-3 but use AEGRPID instead of AESPID.If ECREASC is not missing, then assign the value 'DRUG WITHDRAWN'. Otherwise copy the value from AE.AEACN.
Concatenate the variable values in ECREASC and ECREASCX extracted while deriving ADAE.AAEACN, by colon separated and assign to AECREAS.

1) Merge in the TV.VISIT and TV.VISITDY to the combined EC/SUPPEC dataset by VISITNUM, and create the variable AECREAVS by concatenating the values in TV.VISIT and TV.VISITDY by " DAY " text separated.2) Follow merging approach outlined in ADAE.AAEACN but instead merge on AECREAVS variable derived in step 1 above.

Create two temporary variables AAEACTDC and AAEACTEC to derive AAEACT.1)If UPCASE(ADAE.AAEACN) = "DRUG WITHDRAWN" and ADAE.AECREAVS not missing then assign AAEACTEC= "DRUG WITHDRAWN DOSE: "!!STRIP(PUT(ADAE.ASPER+1,BEST.))!!" AT "!!STRIP(ADAE.AECREAVS). Otherwise if UPCASE(ADAE.AAEACN) = "DRUG WITHDRAWN" and ADAE.AECREAVS is missing then AAEACTEC= "DRUG WITHDRAWN DOSE: "!!STRIP(PUT(ADAE.ASPER+1,BEST.))!!", No link with EC data".2) If UPCASE(ADAE.AAEACNOT) = "WITHDRAWN FROM STUDY" and TV.VISIT not missing THEN assign AAEACTDC= "WITHDRAWN FROM STUDY AT: "!!STRIP(TV.VISIT)!!" DAY "!!STRIP(PUT(TV.VISITDY,BEST.)). Otherwise if ADAE.AAEACNOT = "WITHDRAWN FROM STUDY" and TV.VISIT is missing then assign AAEACTDC= "WITHDRAWN FROM STUDY, No link with DS data".If both the temporary variables derived in the above steps are not missing then concatenate them by " / " separated and assign to AAEACT. Otherwise assign only the non-missing temporary variable.

Description.TranslaODM.DescriptitedText: Calculated age in human years at the start date of the AE (i.e. taking into account leap years), using SAS function YRDIF applying parameter AGE and taking the integer value. Derived as the age at the start date of the adverse event: INT(YRDIF(ADSL.BRTHDT,ADAE.ASTDT,'AGE'));,

Description.TranslatedText: Contains the number of days from the first exposure date in the period that the spontaneous event occurred (if the exposure date is prior to the spontaneous event date), or the first exposure date of the previous period (if the exposure date in this period is after the spontaneous event date) to ADT. If value >=0 then add 1.

The analysis severity is based on the collected severity (AESEV) and if the collected severity is missing, the severity is imputed from the seriousness (AESER) or if seriousness is missing, from the action taken or action taken other values:Equals to ADAE.AESEV if AESEV is not missing; If ADAE.AESEV is missing then if AE.AESER= 'Y' then ASEV = 'Severe' else if AE.AEACN = 'DOSE NOT CHANGED' and, AEACNOTH = 'NONE' then ASEV = 'Mild' else ASEV = 'Moderate'
